hints.content:
Let's figure out the $\maroonD{8^{\text{th}}}$ term in the pattern  by $\greenD{\text{adding 13}}$.

[[☃ image 1]]

The $\maroonD{8^{\text{th}}}$ term in the pattern is $\maroonD{99}$.

options.alt: A series of eight rows numbered 1 through 8. Each number 1 through 8 has an arrow pointing to its corresponding value in the pattern. The top row is 1 with an arrow pointing to 8. Row 2 has an arrow pointing to a 21. Row 3 has an arrow pointing to 34. Row 4 has an arrow pointing to 47. Row 5 has an arrow pointing to 60. Row 6 has an arrow pointing to 73. Row 7 has an arrow pointing to 86. Row 8 has an arrow pointing to 99. Next to rows 1 through 8 is a series of 7 curved arrows connecting the rows, starting at 8 and pointing downward from one row to the next, ending at 99. Each curved arrow is labeled plus 13.

hints.content:
$\maroonD{99}$ is *less than* $100$.

$\maroonD{99}$ is an odd number.

The true statements are:

- It is a multiple of $9$.  

- It is an odd number.
